summary: KKR Asset-Based Income Fund filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that its adviser, KKR Credit Advisors (US) LLC, extended a temporary management-fee reduction to 0.35% annual from 0.50%, now running through the later of May 3, 2031 or aggregate net assets reaching $3 billion, up from a prior $1 billion threshold. Effective August 31, 2026, the fund also eliminated its 5% early repurchase fee in connection with converting from a tender offer fund to an interval fund. No securities, prices, or board recommendations are involved; watch for asset-growth trajectory and interval-fund liquidity terms.
